description: Original Requested Execution Date: Only one of Date (Dt) or DateTime (DtTm) is allowed.
errorMessage: Only one of Date (Dt) or DateTime (DtTm) is allowed
fix: Remove one of the tags from the <OrgnlReqdExctnDt> block.

description: OrgnlReqdColltnDt is a simple ISODate field (not a choice). It must contain a direct YYYY-MM-DD value with no child elements.
errorMessage: Invalid OrgnlReqdColltnDt value. Must be a plain ISO date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-03-30). Do NOT wrap in <Dt> or <DtTm> child tags.

description: OrgnlReqdExctnDt and OrgnlReqdColltnDt are mutually exclusive in camt.055 TxInf. Only ONE date type is permitted per transaction cancellation request.
errorMessage: Either OriginalRequestedExecutionDate or OriginalRequestedCollectionDate must be present, but both can't be present.
fix: Remove either OrgnlReqdExctnDt or OrgnlReqdColltnDt. Keep only the one that matches the original payment instruction.
condition: any(re.match(r'.*\.TxInf(\[\d+\])?\.OrgnlReqdExctnDt', k) for k in DATA.keys()) and any(re.match(r'.*\.TxInf(\[\d+\])?\.OrgnlReqdColltnDt', k) for k in DATA.keys())

description: Assignment Id (Assgnmt.Id) is restricted to maximum 16 characters in CBPR+ camt.055.
errorMessage: This field must be maximum 16 characters long. The current value exceeds 16 characters.
fix: Shorten the Assgnmt.Id value to 16 characters or fewer.

description: BAH Fr/Assgnr BIC mismatch: AppHdr From BIC must equal Assgnmt Assgnr BIC.
errorMessage: BAH "From" BIC must match "Assigner" BIC if CopyDuplicate is absent.
condition: not any('CpyDplct' in k for k in DATA.keys())

description: BAH To/Assgne BIC mismatch: AppHdr To BIC must equal Assgnmt Assgne BIC.
errorMessage: BAH "To" BIC must match "Assignee" BIC if CopyDuplicate is absent.
condition: not any('CpyDplct' in k for k in DATA.keys())

description: Cancellation reason code (CxlRsnInf.Rsn.Cd) must be a valid ExternalCancellationReason code.
OrgnlTxRef must not appear inside TxInf in camt.055 CustomerPaymentCancellationRequest. CBPR+ forbids original transaction reference at TxInf level.
errorMessage: OrgnlTxRef is not allowed inside TxInf of a camt.055 message. Remove the OrgnlTxRef block from TxInf — it is not permitted at this level in camt.055.001.08.
fix: Remove the <OrgnlTxRef> block from within <TxInf>. Original transaction reference data is not permitted at the TxInf level in CustomerPaymentCancellationRequest (camt.055.001.08).

description: Cancellation request must identify the Assigner (Assgnmt.Assgnr).
Cancellation request must identify the Assignee (Assgnmt.Assgne).
Case/Id is mandatory in camt.055 TxInf per CBPR+ schema sequence. Case must appear before OrgnlInstrId.
errorMessage: Missing mandatory <Case><Id> in TxInf. The Case element (with Id and Cretr) is required before OrgnlInstrId in camt.055.001.08 CBPR+.
fix: Add <Case><Id>YOUR-CASE-ID</Id><Cretr><Pty><Nm>...</Nm><PstlAdr>...</PstlAdr></Pty></Cretr></Case> inside <TxInf>, immediately after <CxlId> and before <OrgnlInstrId>.

description: Case/Cretr is mandatory in camt.055 TxInf per CBPR+ schema. Cretr must be present inside Case.
errorMessage: Missing mandatory <Case><Cretr> in TxInf. The Case element requires a Cretr (creator) sub-element in camt.055.001.08 CBPR+.
